summary: Both halves inspected and surely,for me,ahead comma,cap-products placement,reflections,evident,the three cancelled words,the circled star,the boils replacement,The one,Coming and the last blot enlarged. Surely and for me have only placement hooks at their right edges. The cap-products insertion belongs before the original typed comma. Ahead has a typed comma. The circled asterisk is identifiable. Among our and the pen-cancelled as are readable,whereas the relationship cancellation remains unreadable. Boils has a pen-retouched s,and the old u in just remains obscured. The vertical separator after those is pen. No independent parenthesis is secure before Coming;its older initial and the final a remain uncertain.

edits.reason: Surely is a separate typed inserted word. Its right-hand curve is continuous with the placement underline and is not an independent comma.
The comma has the regular typewriter teardrop form and belongs to the baseline typed text.
The placement stem is immediately before the original typed comma. The handwritten phrase closes with a parenthesis and the hooked end of its underline;there is no second comma.
The a bowl is visible beneath the taller live typed d;preserve this typewriter correction.
For me is a separate typed phrase. The final upturn is the placement underline,not a comma.
The first f is retraced in pen and the following l is drawn over a partly visible typed form. The older second letter cannot be securely distinguished between f and l.
The insertion stem falls before the original typed comma,so the comma follows the inserted phrase.
An enclosing loop and crossing central strokes are visible;the handwritten circled asterisk is identifiable.

edits.reason: The old phrase is readable except for the heavily obscured u. The inserted phrase is typed with its s retouched in pen over a partly hidden older form.
The letters of among our,including the descending g and final r,remain visible beneath the typed x strokes.
The h has an additional raised typed impression;its upper fragment is not independently legible enough to name a second letter.
The pen insertion ends with a parenthesis and a placement hook. No independent comma is present before the existing typed period.
The two cancelled forms read as. They are crossed by diagonal pen hatching,not by typed x strokes.
The live pen C is clear. The older curved letter is partly covered and its case is uncertain;the leftmost stroke can belong to the live C and does not establish a separate parenthesis.
The final a-like form is heavily retouched in pen. Its reading remains uncertain rather than being silently resolved.
